content.short: Routescan builds block explorers, APIs and custom blockchain data products across 86+ networks.
content.description: Routescan is a blockchain data company that runs block explorers and data APIs, and builds custom explorers, MCP servers and proof pages for projects on their own domains. It covers more than 86 networks and billions of indexed transactions. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Routescan.
content.meta: Routescan runs block explorers and blockchain data APIs across 86+ networks, listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
